editorial_notes: Garder l'identité du Temple et le CTA, Ahch-To, la Haute République, la transmission maître/apprenti, Naboo, Kamino et Géonosis, Ahsoka et Fives, la chute de la République, les survivants, Luke et Rey. Réduire les visites du Temple qui répètent son rôle ; les scènes retenues donnent elles-mêmes les informations nécessaires à leurs personnages.

join_reviews.before_last_two_sentences: You can subscribe to Deep Void Theories for more of these quiet journeys. I'd also be glad to read where this one finds you, and whether the sun is up or it's nighttime there, if you'd like to leave a comment.
join_reviews.after_first_two_sentences: As the Clone Wars continue into Revenge of the Sith, the Council chamber also becomes a place for military reports and assignments. Jedi who once traveled as negotiators now discuss campaigns.
join_reviews.judgment: OK : reprise après le CTA vers la transformation militaire du Temple ; la référence aux Clone Wars nomme la période.

join_reviews.before_last_two_sentences: The younglings' earlier lesson helps give that loss a familiar shape: children practicing, a teacher listening, a returning Jedi asking for help. Before its fall, the Temple is where those people can find one another, and where the Order gathers the experience it carries home from the wider galaxy.
join_reviews.after_first_two_sentences: On Ahch-To, the first Jedi Temple survives on an island reached by sea and steep stone steps. When Rey arrives, Luke Skywalker is living among its old buildings, far from the Republic the Jedi once served.
join_reviews.judgment: OK thématique : du Temple récent au premier Temple ; Ahch-To, Rey et Luke sont explicitement situés.

join_reviews.before_last_two_sentences: Avar must coordinate across distances, Burryaga must attend to lives others haven't detected, and rescuers must keep finding ways to reach people. Starlight gives that work a permanent base farther from Coruscant.
join_reviews.after_first_two_sentences: Obi-Wan thinks Qui-Gon has pushed the Jedi Council too far over Anakin Skywalker. In The Phantom Menace, he tells his master that following the Council's judgment would spare him this friction.
join_reviews.judgment: OK : fin de l'exemple de la Haute République, puis scène nommée de The Phantom Menace ; aucun personnage secondaire retiré n'est nécessaire.

join_reviews.before_last_two_sentences: Naboo is free. The difficulty for the Jedi is that this liberation hasn't exposed the Sith Master's role in creating the emergency or benefiting from its resolution.
join_reviews.after_first_two_sentences: The dart that kills Zam Wesell gives Obi-Wan a trail he can't follow through the Temple's usual records. Zam has been caught after an attempt on Padme's life, but another attacker silences her before she can identify the person behind it.
join_reviews.judgment: OK : fin du récit de Naboo, puis nouvelle enquête dont la victime et l'attentat sont rappelés immédiatement.

join_reviews.before_last_two_sentences: On Coruscant, clone formations assemble beneath the Republic's leadership as military ships depart. The Jedi now have an army to accompany them, and the emergency rescue on Geonosis has carried them into a war.
join_reviews.after_first_two_sentences: The explosion strikes a hangar in the Jedi Temple, bringing the war into the place where Ahsoka lives and learns. Jedi, clone troopers, and civilian workers are among its victims.
join_reviews.judgment: OK : la guerre commence à Géonosis puis atteint le Temple ; Ahsoka a déjà été introduite dans la transmission maître/apprenti.

join_reviews.before_last_two_sentences: Rex hears the warning and survives the meeting, but no protection reaches the army. The chips remain inside the soldiers the Jedi will take into their next battles.
join_reviews.after_first_two_sentences: Anakin brings Mace Windu the information the Council has been seeking: Chancellor Palpatine is a Sith Lord. He has just left the Chancellor alive after confronting him with a lightsaber.
join_reviews.judgment: OK : la menace des implants reste sans réponse ; la révélation de Palpatine est un événement distinct clairement annoncé par Anakin.

join_reviews.before_last_two_sentences: The Senate receives a story of a defeated rebellion while the surviving Jedi are still trying to escape their own troops. The army that served the Republic now enforces Palpatine's imperial rule.
join_reviews.after_first_two_sentences: Obi-Wan changes the signal in the Jedi Temple so that any surviving Jedi will know to stay away. The transmission had been calling them back to Coruscant, where clone soldiers now occupy their home.
join_reviews.judgment: OK : les survivants évitent les clones ; le signal du Temple est expliqué avant sa modification.

join_reviews.before_last_two_sentences: They have changed a dangerous signal, confronted the Sith, and placed two children in homes beyond the ruined Temple. Their work now continues at that smaller scale, with Leia held by her new parents and Luke in Beru's arms beside Owen.
join_reviews.after_first_two_sentences: Obi-Wan places Anakin Skywalker's lightsaber in Luke's hands on Tatooine before Luke knows what happened to its owner. In A New Hope, the weapon connects him to a father he's been told was a navigator on a spice freighter.
join_reviews.judgment: OK : Luke confié à sa famille puis Luke adulte recevant le sabre ; A New Hope situe ce saut temporel. Fin Luke/Rey conservée.

review_scope: Manual selection by story function. Actual chapter openings and closings, condensed retained passages and every new two-sided join read. All original chapter hashes and exact retained substrings verified. No new factual claims or external fact-check; final audio remains ungenerated and must be checked separately.
